sentences.text: The gold-loan FAQ describes a gold loan as a loan against pledged gold ornaments, but it does not state any processing fee for gold loans.
The bank’s gold-loan FAQ also gives the loan tenure and loan-to-value description, but it still does not disclose a processing-fee amount for that product.
The only processing-charges material in the bank’s in-force rules is a table header for processing charges by interest-rate/tenure bands, and it does not provide a gold-loan-specific fee amount.
I searched the in-force gold-loan FAQ and the in-force processing-charges table, and I could not find a gold-loan processing-fee amount.

missing.searched: in-force gold-loan FAQ and in-force processing-charges table
